Center outlets such as Reuters, AP, CNN, and the Financial Times used neutral wire-style verbs ("drafts," "fall," "calls for") and confined themselves to plain factual description. At the furthest right, the New York Post and Washington Examiner amplified Vance's "Trojan horse" characterization of AI leaders, and The Free Press used the charged verb "stealing" to describe China's role, shifting the story toward national-security threat framing rather than a domestic regulatory debate.
